# EWP/1 codec: frame header, bounded CBOR subset, CRC-32. Pure C++ (no IDF
# APIs) so the same sources build in test/host under ASan/UBSan.
#
# The wire constants come from the TypeScript contract: ewp_protocol.h is
# GENERATED by packages/protocol (npm run gen:c -w @ionity/ewp) and included
# from there by path - never copied, so firmware and gateway cannot drift.
# Override the location with the EWP_PROTOCOL_DIR environment variable.

set(ewp_protocol_dir "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../../../packages/protocol/generated")
if(DEFINED ENV{EWP_PROTOCOL_DIR})
    set(ewp_protocol_dir "$ENV{EWP_PROTOCOL_DIR}")
endif()
get_filename_component(ewp_protocol_dir "${ewp_protocol_dir}" ABSOLUTE)
if(NOT EXISTS "${ewp_protocol_dir}/ewp_protocol.h")
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "ewp_protocol.h not found in ${ewp_protocol_dir}.\n"
        "Build from the monorepo (packages/protocol/generated) or set EWP_PROTOCOL_DIR.")
endif()

idf_component_register(
    SRCS "src/crc32.cpp" "src/cbor.cpp" "src/frame.cpp"
    INCLUDE_DIRS "include" "${ewp_protocol_dir}")

if(IONITY_STRICT_WARNINGS)
    target_compile_options(${COMPONENT_LIB} PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror -Wshadow)
endif()
